controls.name: La natatio e i giochi - Swimming pools and games

axis: Positive X follows the transverse bath axis southeast, from the western to the eastern palaestra. Positive Z follows the central axis southwest, from the natatio toward the surviving caldarium fragment.
limits: The visible ruins follow the mapped exterior rings and courtyards. Upper wall profiles, arch dimensions and surviving fabric are modeled from current photographs.
The baths remain open to the sky. The source represents standing fabric and visible perimeter remnants, with underground rooms and lost roofs outside the scope.
Footings meet the standard viewer terrain. Small excavated grade changes and individual masonry courses are approximated.
